description: Shared base of the end-to-end Neuralese stage for both lines (owner decision 2026-10-12: start the E2E arm now, in parallel with SFT; plans/REVIEW_20261012.md item 2; design plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "End-to-end stage"). It starts from a direct export (a neuralese_direct checkpoint exported by train/direct_export.py) bound as input_bindings.direct_artifact by the launch recipe that extends a line recipe; that binding is a lineage key, not a parity setting. Two stages: direct_runtime runs the exact runtime qualification of that export on the stage's machine (eval/direct_runtime.py: writer, cache readback, producer replay and input adjoints, typed wire); e2e trains train/trajectories.py --direct-artifact on the union e2e cohort neuralese-e2e-union-cohort-20261012-v1 (1389 records, 769 train / 620 held, 1137 producer->consumer edges: the authenticated 1243-record cohort byte-identically plus every other union source with child-result write/read sites, selected by the same rule; registered, scripts/neuralese_data/build_e2e_union_cohort.py): producers write their child results with the shared direct writer (token-driven, one Neuralese value per crisp token, generated-length stops), consumers read the written block, the identity TokenChoiceProjection comes on at step 0 (logits equal the export's), the backbone latents train on MuonSR (cubic5, wd 0.1, spike clip 5) and step inside the layer-staged backward, with the shared drift monitor (response KL warns 0.5, stops 1.5; the 48-probe behaviour gate is reported only, owner 2026-10-12) and the line's QAT component held at its parent's curriculum progress. Acceptance (e2e_acceptance, train/e2e_acceptance.py, written as e2e-certificate.json): consumers reading values against consumers reading the gold tokens on the same held producer calls (V CE at most T CE; V beats shuffled and zeroed blocks by 0.05 nats; at least 32 paired readers), exact-oracle task success (V at most 0.02 below T), and no drift stop. Lines: neuralese-e2e-mellum-v1 (DGX), neuralese-e2e-lfm-v1 (Pop); every difference is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json.

quantization.description: Shared QAT of the end-to-end stage (owner: QAT in every stage, light on LFM; lockstep of both lines): the direct base's q4 point (int4 g32), held at its parent's curriculum progress. After the full direct lineage (direct_sft [0, 0.75], direct_trajectory [0.75, 1.0]) that is 1.0, so q4 is at lambda 1 and sampled at weight 0.5 beside BF16. A launch from a mid-lineage snapshot holds the snapshot's progress instead (its launch recipe overrides stage_progress.e2e). Lines add points only where the backbone deploys lower (Mellum). The nested family is not trained in e2e yet (gap, both lines).

e2e_acceptance.description: NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "End-to-end stage" section 4 and its resolved margins; T reads the gold crisp text (teacher-oracle reference); the greedy-T arm, the token-readout regression (eval/direct_token_readout.py) and the behaviour gate are reported.

parent_readiness.description: When a line's running direct phase hands off into this lineage (owner 2026-10-12: e2e replaces text-only SFT once ready, without waiting for the phase's full epoch). Checked on the direct phase's own logs by train/e2e_acceptance.py readiness; the same criterion and the same moment rule for both lines (lockstep, plans/neuralese/TRAINING_RECIPE.md). Held CE plateau: over the last 3 held evaluations on one held set, at most 2% relative improvement; no drift stop; held task success at least the base's once the direct phase measures it (until then reported, plans/REVIEW_20261012.md item 1). The handoff itself: the phase stops at a checkpoint (--handoff with stop_at, or a signal), that checkpoint is exported (train/direct_export.py), and the line's launch recipe extending neuralese-e2e-<line>-v1 binds the export; this lineage's direct_runtime stage qualifies those exact weights before any e2e update.
